Record Attempt

50 Runs, 50 States

Goodwin Generated Mission America is structured as an attempt to set a Guinness World Records mark by completing a marathon in all 50 U.S. states inside a 24-day window. The public route list below keeps the attempt easy to follow.

Target
50

Certified marathon-distance runs across all 50 states.

Window
24

Consecutive days from the Hawaii launch to the New York finish.

Proof
Live

Tracking, route data, timestamps, media, and crew documentation support the attempt archive.
